Evaluate heart rate, SpO2, blood pressure, sleep, steps and other vitals. Detect abnormalities, then compute an overall healthScore (0-100), an overallHealth label (Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Critical) and a concise clinical summary. Ignore fields that are 0/N/A/'none' as unavailable rather than abnormal.

parameters.content:
## VitalCare AI — Elder Care Monitoring
POST resident vitals to /webhook/vitalcare-ai. The payload is validated, analyzed by 5 sequential Groq AI agents, persisted to Firestore, and returned to the React app as one JSON object.

### Normalize & Validate
Coerces types, clamps out-of-range vitals, fills missing fields with safe defaults, and records data quality flags.

### AI Agents (Groq)
1) Health Monitoring 2) Risk Prediction 3) Emergency 4) Recommendation 5) Caregiver Report. Each uses a structured output parser for guaranteed JSON.

### Assemble + Store + Respond
Merges all agent outputs into the frontend contract, derives riskLevel, saves to Firestore, and responds with JSON + CORS headers.
